items:
Welcome to your Seacrest Beach luxury retreat, a thoughtfully designed coastal home located in the heart of Seacrest Beach II, perfectly positioned between Rosemary Beach and Alys Beach along Scenic Highway 30A. This home offers an ideal balance of walkability, privacy, and upscale comfort, making it a standout choice for families, couples, and multi-generational groups looking for a refined beach experience.

One of the most unique features of this home is its setting. A peaceful walking trail runs directly behind the house, creating a lush, quiet backdrop that is perfect for morning strolls, evening walks, or simply enjoying a sense of space and calm. Despite this tranquil setting, you are just steps away from the charm, dining, shopping, and coastal beauty of Rosemary Beach, and centrally located between Rosemary Beach and Alys Beach, two of the most sought-after destinations on 30A.

Guests enjoy deeded beach access along with seasonal tram service available March through October, making beach days easy and convenient, especially for families. The home also includes access to the Seacrest Beach Lagoon Pool, one of the largest and most impressive resort-style pools on 30A, offering a perfect alternative to the beach for relaxing afternoons.

Inside, the home features a spacious and well-designed layout with four bedrooms, including two true primary suites, a rare and highly desirable feature for vacation homes in this area. The upstairs primary suite features a king bed and feels like a private spa retreat, complete with a large soaking tub, separate walk-in shower, and generous bathroom space designed for relaxation after a day at the beach. This suite offers privacy, comfort, and a peaceful escape.

The main-level primary suite features a queen bed and is ideal for guests who prefer easy access without stairs. This suite includes a walk-in shower, double sinks, and a private toilet area, offering both comfort and convenience while maintaining a sense of privacy.

In addition to the primary suites, the home includes two additional bedrooms designed to accommodate a wide range of guests. One bedroom features a queen bed and its own private balcony, making it a wonderful space for adult guests, teens, or a second couple who appreciate a quiet place to enjoy morning coffee or evening breezes. The fourth bedroom is designed with families and children in mind and offers a warm, kid-friendly feel while still maintaining the home’s elevated coastal aesthetic. This room includes a bunk bed with a trundle that sleeps three, along with an additional queen bed, making it spacious enough to comfortably host an entire family with young children in one room.

The main living areas are open, bright, and welcoming, designed for connection and comfort. Natural light fills the space, and the relaxed coastal design creates an inviting environment for gathering, movie nights, or simply unwinding together. The living area flows seamlessly into the dining space and kitchen, making it easy to enjoy time together whether you’re cooking, dining, or relaxing.

The kitchen is fully equipped and thoughtfully stocked to support everything from simple breakfasts to full family meals. With full-size appliances, ample counter space, and all the essential cookware and serving items, the kitchen makes staying in just as enjoyable as dining out.

Additional amenities include high-speed WiFi, cable television, a washer and dryer, central air conditioning, and a well-maintained, professionally cared-for interior. Every detail of the home has been considered to create a stay that feels effortless and comfortable from arrival to departure.

Outdoor living is a key part of the experience here, whether you’re enjoying the walking trail behind the home, relaxing at the lagoon pool, or heading to the beach via the tram or on foot. The location allows you to walk, bike, or explore with ease while still returning to a peaceful and upscale neighborhood at the end of the day.

This home is ideal for families who want space and flexibility, couples traveling together who value privacy, and guests who appreciate luxury without pretension. With its rare dual primary suite layout, family-friendly sleeping arrangements, and prime location near Rosemary and Alys Beach, it offers a combination that works beautifully in real life, not just on paper.

This is a thoughtfully cared-for retreat designed for guests who value comfort, quality, and an exceptional location. Whether you’re here to explore 30A, relax by the pool, walk to dinner in Rosemary Beach, or simply slow down and recharge, this Seacrest Beach home provides the perfect setting for a memorable stay.
